# @param {Integer[]} nums
# @return {Integer}
def count_triplets(nums)
  count = Hash.new(0)
  n = nums.size

  # Precompute all pairwise AND counts
  n.times do |i|
    n.times do |j|
      count[nums[i] & nums[j]] += 1
    end
  end

  ans = 0
  n.times do |k|
    count.each do |and_val, c|
      # If nums[k] & and_val == 0, all triples with that AND sum are valid
      ans += c if (nums[k] & and_val) == 0
    end
  end

  ans
end
